form.title: Merchant payouts stuck since this afternoon
form.impact: No merchant payouts have been sent for about 20 minutes; over 1,500 are waiting.
form.details:
Merchants are asking why today's payouts have not arrived.
The payouts dashboard shows a growing queue. FX rates still update normally.
Nothing was deployed to partner-gateway today.

expected_cause: The bank-partner mTLS client certificate expired (renewal SEC-4471 never approved); no release is involved.
